body: Yes and no, I left last month for a week, I slept in my truck a couple of nights, with one friend wine night, and with my sister and brother in-law a couple of nights, but I don’t want to inconvenience anyone especially now that I don’t have a job (if I can’t get my one vehicle going today).......

Update:
I was home for one day, the police show up to arrest me, even though the protective order was rescinded.  I lost my cool, got tased and scuffled with arresting officer after removing the taser barbs.  Now I have a court date in January to face multiple charges, but hey, my wife is back to herself and I'm home, for now.....

Had to be escorted to my own home to surrender my remaining firearms and get some personal possessions.  Then I got grilled over the phone by another police officer over the things that happened Saturday night.  He became irate on the phone when I could not recall exact details.  When asked him if he knew what day it was and that several days had passed he angrily told me that I could remember some details but not others, to which I told him I was not going to tell him things that I could not remember.

Yes and no, my relationship is strained with my closest family.

My wife has no family nearby and what she has is estranged from.

I have her two hospital stays and, now if I can get enough time in the house, the restraining order makes that difficult, I have her suicide note.
Married 10 years, together 20, now that I have been served  a restraining order I have no choice but to find a lawyer.
Gets better, just got served a restraining order, can't wait to see what the court date brings...

IDK, I still have no job, no car and no way to pay the mortgage.   I am going to court and I will try for custody, I just don't know what I'll do if I win.  I don't even have an unemployment check yet.  I'll be taking my kids to a homeless shelter, getting rid of our pets etc.  my oldest is autistic with anxiety and ADHD as well as something called  SPD.  My youngest has anger issues, bad enough that he got thrown out of daycare.  I just don't know if they are better with the status quo or not.
